summary: Submitted unchanged; validated as no_change with no effects. The run is finished with three research records. Two are sourced defects, each with an experiment-cited account whose conclusion is violated and whose defect claim is asserted: (1) configuration recovery - with Config.RestoreCommittedLogs enabled, NewRaft advances lastApplied to the persisted commit index before the startup configuration scan, so committed configuration entries at or below that bound are never processed and the node keeps the snapshot's or an empty configuration, which can leave it unable to elect itself, make it commit and report success for an entry decided by a member set the committed configuration does not contain, write the loss into its own snapshot metadata so a later restart with the feature disabled restores it, and prevent it from ever becoming a candidate while it still votes for healthy peers - supported by eight retained receipts including the four single-voter cases with flag-off controls, the three-voter commit-rule witness reproduced in four receipts, the durable-snapshot case, the authority pair with a premise-failure repeat and a premise-enforcing revision, and the two-voter vote boundary in two executions; and (2) replay completion - the startup replay blocks forever once it needs more than 128 delivered batches, because the FSM channel's only consumer starts after the replay returns and the send has no timeout, with the bound measured as 128 x MaxAppendEntries delivered batches at two batch sizes and shown reachable with the library's default snapshot settings, plus a measured availability consequence in a three-voter group. The third record is the source-analyzed open question on whether a stale snapshot's configuration reaches a joiner through InstallSnapshot, with its two readings separated and a concrete persistent path identified plus a discriminator, but no execution. Three knowledge corrections are recorded with changed premises, affected uses and answered gaps; 54 claims across 14 receipts were verified against the observations with no discrepancy and all cited source anchors re-checked, including the compaction rule that forbids removing logs after a snapshot. One internal contradiction was repaired, the failed predecessor receipt is retained without a comparison claim, and the remaining limits are structural to the in-memory harness. Expiry preserves this state; no uncitable work was started.
